description: What seat height of stool suits a counter or bar (10 to 12 inches below its top), and how many stools fit along it. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

height.description: Counter or bar height from the floor to the top, in inches.

kind.description: plain: backless or side stools up to 22 inches wide. arms: stools with arms or wider than 22 inches. Default plain.

length.description: Length of counter where the stools go, in inches. Optional.

name: bar_stool_height
title: Bar stool height calculator
